1.consolidated_definition: Insecto volador de hasta 27 mm de longitud, de cuerpo estrecho y aplanado, de color pardo con dos manchas amarillentas a los lados del tórax, por las cuales despide de noche una luz azulada bastante viva. Lampyridae; Pyrophorus luminosus.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Flying insect up to 27 mm in length, with a narrow and flattened body, brown in color and featuring two yellowish spots on the sides of the thorax, from which it emits a bright blue-green light at night. Family Lampyridae; species Pyrophorus luminosus.
